Position Title: Field Technician

Location: Dixon, California
Position Summary
The Field Technician is responsible for providing on-site technical support, installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of hardware, software, network, and peripheral equipment. This role serves as the primary point of contact for end users at customer locations, ensuring timely resolution of technical issues while maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction and service quality.
Key Responsibilities
Technical Support
· Provide on-site and remote technical support for network, server and peripheral equipment.
· Diagnose and resolve hardware, software, operating system, and connectivity issues.
· Perform equipment installation, configuration, upgrades, and replacements.
· Troubleshoot wired network connectivity issues.
Field Services
· Travel to customer sites to perform break-fix services, equipment deployments, and technology refresh initiatives.
· Execute device installations, moves, adds, and changes according to established procedures.
· Provide hands-and-eyes support for infrastructure, server, and network teams when required.
Asset & Inventory Management
· Maintain accurate records of hardware inventory and asset assignments.
· Coordinate device receiving, deployment, collection, and disposal activities.
· Ensure compliance with asset management and security policies.
Customer Service
· Deliver professional and responsive support to end users and business stakeholders.
· Communicate technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
· Escalate unresolved issues appropriately and follow through until resolution.
· Maintain detailed documentation of incidents, service requests, and resolutions.
Operational Excellence
· Manage tickets and service requests within agreed service level targets.
· Follow established IT processes, security policies, and compliance requirements.
· Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and knowledge-sharing activities.
· Participate in special projects, office moves, and technology rollouts as needed.
Required Qualifications
· Associate's degree, technical certification, or equivalent work experience.
· 2+ years of experience in desktop support, field services, or technical support.
· Experience troubleshooting hardware, software, and network issues.
· Familiarity with Active Directory, device management tools, and ticketing systems.
· Valid driver's license and ability to travel to customer locations.
Preferred Qualifications
· CompTIA A+, Network+, or Microsoft certifications.
· Experience supporting enterprise environments.
· Knowledge of ITIL service management practices.
· Experience with mobile device management (MDM) solutions.
· Basic understanding of networking, servers, and cloud technologies.
Skills & Competencies
· Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
· Excellent customer service orientation.
· Effective verbal and written communication skills.
· Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
· Strong organizational and time management skills.
· Ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
Physical Requirements
· Ability to lift and move equipment up to 50 pounds.
· Ability to travel between customer sites and office locations.
· Capability to work in server rooms, office environments, and remote locations as required.
Work Environment
· Combination of customer-site support, office work, and remote support activities.
· Standard business hours with occasional after-hours or weekend support requirements.
· Travel may be required based on business and customer needs.

jobs.description:
Job Details

Description

Working with a high degree of ownership and attention to detail, the Clinical Documentation Specialist reviews documentation for completeness, identifies gaps or inconsistencies, communicates documentation requirements, and helps resolve documentation barriers that may delay patient care or reimbursement.

Core Competencies

Analytical Thinking & Problem Solving – Evaluates complex datasets, identifies trends and root causes, and develops actionable recommendations.
Vendor Data Curiosity – Identifies data gaps and partners with vendors to define, validate, and operationalize new data fields.
Self-Initiative – Prioritizes work, investigates issues independently, and proactively brings forward solutions without requiring detailed direction.
Adaptability – Thrives in dynamic environments where workflows, systems, reporting requirements, and business priorities evolve rapidly.
Quality & Accuracy – Ensures data integrity through validation, proactively identifies discrepancies, and delivers reporting leaders can trust.
Business Partnership – Collaborates effectively across Operations, Revenue Cycle, Order Management, Patient Access, Patient Experience, Sales, Finance, IT, and external vendor partners.
Communication & Strategic Insight – Translates complex data into clear, actionable insights through dashboards, reports, presentations, and executive-level recommendations.
Change Leadership – Challenges existing processes, identifies opportunities for improvement, and helps drive organizational change through data-driven insights.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Business Intelligence & Reporting

Develop and maintain dashboards, KPI scorecards, operational reports, and recurring reporting packages.
Build reporting for Patient Access, Intake, Post-Ship Support, Order Management, Revenue Cycle, Patient Experience, Workers’ Compensation, Personal Injury, Sales, Finance, and Leadership.
Monitor organizational and departmental performance against established KPIs, operational goals, service levels, and productivity expectations.
Analyze data to identify trends, risks, opportunities, bottlenecks, and root causes; translate findings into practical recommendations.

Vendor Data Field Identification & Capture

Identify missing or incomplete data fields needed for KPI tracking, workflow management, reporting, and business decisions.
Partner with vendors, system owners, and stakeholders to define, request, validate, and implement new data fields.
Document field definitions, expected values, reporting purpose, downstream operational impact, and data collection requirements.
Create interim tracking methods when required data is not available through existing systems or vendor platforms.

Data Management & Analytics

Write, maintain, and validate SQL queries to extract and analyze operational, vendor, and enterprise data.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reporting integrity across multiple systems.
Support KPI standardization, metric definitions, reporting governance, and data quality improvement.
Use Excel, SQL, Tableau, Power BI, and similar tools to extract, transform, analyze, and visualize business data.
Leverage AI and automation tools to improve reporting efficiency, reduce manual reporting, and generate insights.

Patient Access, Intake & Contact Center Analytics

Report on referral volume, intake productivity, call performance, conversion rates, order completion, and intake turnaround times.
Monitor individual and team performance metrics such as service levels, speed to answer, abandonment rate, first call resolution, handle time, quality, and work queues.
Evaluate intake workflow efficiency, referral aging, order abandonment, and process gaps affecting patient onboarding.
Conduct root cause analysis for patient cancellations, escalations, complaint patterns, service failures, and delayed order progression.

Post-Ship Support Analytics

Analyze post-shipment interactions, including delivery confirmation, education, troubleshooting, resupply, billing inquiries, satisfaction, and issue resolution.
Evaluate trends related to product issues, shipping delays, returns, delivery failures, escalations, and patient complaints.
Design dashboards for delivery success, follow-up compliance, patient engagement, utilization, and post-shipment support performance.
Identify workflow gaps that affect timely patient follow-up, billing readiness, issue resolution, and ongoing patient support.

Process Improvement & Operational Partnership

Partner with operational leaders to identify inefficiencies, workflow gaps, reporting needs, and improvement opportunities.
Translate operational challenges into measurable, data-driven solutions and recommendations.
Measure the effectiveness of operational, vendor, process, and business changes.
Present insights through dashboards, summaries, presentations, and recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.

Required

Experience & Education

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Analytics, Finance, Statistics, Information Systems, Mathematics, Healthcare Administration, or related field, or equivalent experience.
3 to 5 years of experience in business intelligence, reporting, analytics, revenue operations, healthcare analytics, call center analytics, data analysis, or a related field.
Advanced SQL and Excel skills.
Experience developing dashboards, scorecards, data visualizations, and recurring reporting solutions.
Strong problem-solving, analytical thinking, and data validation skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, recurring reports, and ad hoc analytical requests.
Strong communication skills with the ability to present insights clearly to operational and leadership audiences.
Demonstrated ability to identify missing data, define reporting requirements, and partner with stakeholders or vendors to improve data capture.

Preferred

Healthcare, DME, revenue cycle, workers’ compensation, personal injury, patient access, intake, order management, or call center experience.
Experience working with vendor platforms and requesting or validating new reporting fields.
Experience supporting executive leadership teams.
Exposure to Lean, Six Sigma, Continuous Improvement, or other process improvement methodologies.
Knowledge of healthcare insurance processes, patient intake workflows, billing operations, post-shipment support, and DME operations.

Candidates should have experience with several of the following technologies:

Core Technologies: SQL, Tableau, Advanced Microsoft Excel, Power BI, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, and Microsoft Planner.
Preferred Experience: NetSuite, ShipStation, Dialpad, NikoHealth, Emitrr, Alteryx, and other healthcare, revenue cycle, CRM, or enterprise reporting platforms.

Success in This Role

Within The First 6–12 Months, This Individual Will

Improve visibility into operational performance, patient access trends, post-ship support, and revenue-enabling workflows.
Reduce manual reporting through automation and improved data capture.
Establish trusted KPI reporting, metric definitions, and reporting governance standards.
Identify vendor data gaps and help implement new fields needed for reporting and operational decisions.
Deliver recommendations that improve productivity, service quality, patient experience, and operational outcomes.
Serve as a go-to resource for operational insights, business intelligence, vendor data questions, and reporting improvement.

in Houston, Texas

Strong analytical mindset with the ability to connect data, business context, and project outcomes.
Clear communicator who can simplify complex analysis for senior leaders, project teams, and operational stakeholders.
Detail-oriented and disciplined in data validation, documentation, follow-through, and quality of deliverables.
Collaborative working style with the ability to build trust across functions, regions, and levels of the organization.
Curious and proactive in identifying better ways to organize, analyze, visualize, and use data to support project delivery.
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, global environment with multiple priorities, shifting deadlines, and ambiguity.
Outcome-focused, with a practical understanding of how analytics supports execution, operational excellence, and business impact.

Experience supporting project management, program management, business operations, strategic initiatives, or portfolio reporting preferred.

Good Company does good work for good people. We're a Springfield, Missouri third-party logistics company that our e-commerce clients treat as an extension of their own brand. That bet is this role.

You'll join a small Information team in the middle of its most exciting chapter — replacing spreadsheets, legacy BI, and vendor workarounds with a modern platform we own:
Build internal tools people use the next day
— dashboards, ops tools, and client-facing reporting on our stack (TypeScript, Next.js, Supabase/Postgres, BigQuery, Vercel).
Connect systems that don't talk to each other
— our WMS, billing, accounting, carrier, and Slack ecosystems all have APIs; you'll make them one system instead of ten.
Solve problems worth real dollars
— automated reporting, billing-error detection, shipping-anomaly monitoring. The problems here aren't hypothetical; catching them is worth six figures a year.
Turn hours into software
— every recurring manual process in the business is a candidate for automation, and you'll have the mandate to go after them.
Own things end to end
— you scope it, build it, ship it, and stand behind it. No ticket queue, no committee.

Who you are
We hire for traits first, résumé second:
A problem-solver who happens to use technology
— you're drawn to the itch of an unsolved problem more than to any particular tool.
Strong on fundamentals
— you understand what's happening under the tools you use: how the data is modeled, what the API actually returns, why the query is slow, what breaks when the request fails.
Fluent with AI, and accountable for it

A finisher
— you ship. You'd rather deliver something real this week than something perfect never.
Curious
— you want to know why the number is wrong, not just that it is. (Ask us about our core values — curiosity is one of them, and we mean it.)
An owner
— when something you built breaks, you're the first to know and the first to fix it.
A translator
— you can sit with an account manager or a CFO, understand what they actually need, and come back with something better than what they asked for.

API integration experience — REST, webhooks, OAuth, the fun parts and the cursed parts
TypeScript, Python, or both
Experience in logistics, e-commerce, or another operations-heavy business

A greenfield platform build with direct, visible P&L impact
No layers, no six-week sprint ceremonies — you'll talk to the people who use what you build, often the same day you build it
Leadership that has already bought into modern tooling — you're not here to convince anyone it matters
A small team where your work is the difference, and everyone knows it

Skip the cover letter. Send us:
Your résumé (or LinkedIn, or GitHub — whatever tells your story best), and
A short note about something you built that solved a real problem.

Good Company does good work for good people. We're a Springfield, Missouri third-party logistics company that our e-commerce clients treat as an extension of their own brand. Build internal tools people use the next day

Turn hours into software

Own things end to end
— you scope it, build it, ship it, and stand behind it. No ticket queue, no committee.

We hire for traits first, résumé second:
A problem-solver who happens to use technology
— you're drawn to the itch of an unsolved problem more than to any particular tool.

Curious

An owner
— when something you built breaks, you're the first to know and the first to fix it.

Experience in logistics, e-commerce, or another operations-heavy business

A small team where your work is the difference, and everyone knows it

Skip the cover letter. Send us:

A short note about something you built that solved a real problem.

Looking for an Opportunity to Make an Impact?

At Leidos
, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are committed to our customers’ success. Your greatest work is ahead!

Leidos’ Defense Sensor is seeking a Program Coordinator
to support our Persistent Surveillance Portfolio. This is an exciting opportunity for a highly organized and detail-oriented professional who thrives in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

In this role, you will be responsible for providing comprehensive program management support to ensure the program runs smoothly and efficiently. You will work closely with program managers, engineers, government contracting officers, subcontractors and play a key role in supporting the procurement process.

If this sounds like the kind of environment where you can thrive, keep reading!

About Leidos Defense Systems

Leidos’ Defense Systems Sector delivers a broad portfolio of systems, solutions, and services across land, sea, air, space, and cyberspace domains for customers worldwide. Our capabilities include enterprise and mission IT, large-scale intelligence systems, command and control, geospatial and data analytics, cybersecurity, logistics, training, and intelligence analysis and operations support.

We tackle some of the world's toughest security challenges for customers with mission-critical needs.

Primary Responsibilities

Coordinate and manage program schedule, budget, communication, and documentation.
Maintain program calendars, deadlines, budget, and milestones.
Assist with the procurement process, including researching potential vendors, preparing requisitions, and managing purchase orders.
Assist with travel arrangements and logistics for program meetings and conferences.
Manage program databases and ensure accurate data entry.
Prepare presentations and reports as needed.
Perform other administrative duties as assigned.

Basic Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree (preferably in Business Administration, Public Administration, or a related field) and 4–8 years of experience in program administration, preferably in a government contracting environment or Master’s degree (preferably in Business Administration, Public Administration, or a related field) and 2–6 years of experience in program administration, preferably in a government contracting environment.
Proven experience supporting complex programs and projects.
Excellent organizational and time management skills.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
Must be a US citizen, possess an active DoD Secret Security Clearanceor ability to obtain secret clearance.
Must reside in or be willing to relocate to Huntsville, AL

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Microsoft Project and creating/managing Integrated Master Schedules (IMSs)
Experience with procurement processes, including vendor research, requisition preparation, and purchase order management.
Experience on construction management projects.

If you believe you are the victim of a scam, contact your local law enforcement and report the incident to the U.S. Federal Trade Commission.
